content.comment_body: Hello, I'm attempting to set up an OPC connection from a [product_name] [article_no] to my PC for use in a VB.net application I've developed. I have the [product_name] software with [product_name] and [product_name] [version_no], which support OPC communication. Is there any official manual or guidance available to help configure this connection? I've looked extensively through forum posts and help documentation, but I haven't found anything that truly explains the setup process. Thanks,
Is there a way to use the OPC server from [product_name]? I already have the [product_name] license, and it would be disappointing not to utilize it.

Hi, Consider these steps: 1. Create a server connection in [product_name]. 2. Start the OPC-Server and check for a [product_name] driver. If that's unavailable, try the S7-200 driver. 3. See if you can read I0.0 (corresponds to I1 on [product_name]). If successful, you'll have direct access to DI, DQ, M, and VM memory. Other data types such as date & time, analog inputs/outputs/flags use a unique format compared to other controllers. You can map these using the VM-Mapping Table in [product_name] to access the correct VM address. For example, for an analog input: AI -> analog amplifier -> VM-Mapping Table -> VW xxx Hope this helps.

Some technical instructions regarding connectivity and data mapping were shared, but no manufacturer-provided resource was identified.
